Pakistan to invite India to 2027 SCO Summit as host

Pakistan has indicated it will invite India to the 2027 Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit, which it is scheduled to host. This invitation is being extended as part of Pakistan's host obligations for the summit. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to be invited to attend the event in Islamabad.
